label: Go-to-Market Engineering
about: For B2B companies you got from an export of your own Clay, Apollo or HubSpot account. It reads their website for GTM signals: hiring for SDR, AE or RevOps roles, a CRM you can build on, and the demo path (no instant way to book a demo, no chat or qualification). Hiring and a CRM are signals in your favour; the missing demo path is the gap you lead with. Public pages only.

checks.missing: Hiring for sales or revenue ops ({quote})
checks.label: Hiring SDR, AE or RevOps
look_for: (?:we'?re hiring|now hiring|open (?:roles|positions)|join our team|careers)[^.]{0,250}?(?P<q1>(?:sales|business) development rep(?:resentative)?|\bSDRs?\b|\bBDRs?\b|account executive|\bAEs?\b|revenue operations|\brevops\b|sales operations|sales ops|head of (?:sales|growth|revenue)|growth marketer)
checks.gap_line: you're hiring for {quote}, which usually means the pipeline process is still manual

checks.missing: No instant way to book a demo
checks.label: Book a demo with a calendar
look_for: book a demo|request a demo|schedule a demo|get a demo|see a demo|calendly|chili ?piper|hubspot\.com/meetings|savvycal|cal\.com|default\.com|navattic
checks.gap_line: there's no instant way to book a demo, so interested visitors wait for a reply

checks.label: Chat or qualification on the site
checks.gap_line: there's no live chat or instant qualification, so high-intent visitors leave without a conversation

opener: Hi {contact_first}, I looked at how {business} handles inbound and noticed {gap_line}. I build the enrichment, routing and follow-up layer on top of the CRM you already have. I mapped what it would look like for {business} on one page; want me to send it? If it's not relevant, say so and I won't follow up.
